binding.rule: The tool projection calls the shared indexing module; it contains no indexing or cube-transform logic.

tools.name: binary_cube_list_subcube_indexing_modes
tools.description: List standalone subcube multi-input indexing modes and their research purpose.

tools.name: binary_cube_build_subcube_index_plan
tools.description: Build and validate a deterministic collision-free plan mapping each logical source bit to fan-out physical cube-entry positions.

tools.name: binary_cube_validate_subcube_index_plan
tools.description: Reject malformed, colliding, out-of-range, incomplete, or region-incompatible subcube index plans.

tools.name: binary_cube_encode_subcube_inputs
tools.description: Encode logical source bits into a fan-out physical input field using a validated plan or plan options.

tools.name: binary_cube_decode_subcube_inputs
tools.description: Strictly decode a physical subcube input field; corrupted or non-codeword observations fail rather than silently producing plaintext.

tools.name: binary_cube_analyze_subcube_coverage
tools.description: Report expansion, collisions and physical placement distribution across subcube regions.

tools.name: binary_cube_subcube_indexing_self_test
tools.description: Run deterministic fan-out 1/3 tests for both replication and keyed-codeword modes, exact recovery, collision freedom, expansion accounting and distinct-region coverage.

promotionBoundary: These tools expose a standalone strengthening experiment. They must not be described as part of ordinary Binary Cube encryption until runtime tests and comparative post-cube strength measurements justify promotion.
